Metadata.Goal: 在 Kunun public type system 中建立与 field、method、relation primitive 区分的 typed navigation property，并供 source-first 与 code-first 共用。
Metadata.Description: 扩展 RowMember kind、typed prop binding、metadata preservation 和 programmatic construction equivalence，同时保持 runtime accessor 与 package boundary。

TaskSpace.name: add-typed-navigation-property-model
TaskSpace.Description: 用显式 member kind 和 typed prop binding 补齐 Kunun navigation property authority。

TaskGroup.name: Typed Property Contract
TaskGroup.Description: 先建立失败测试，再实现 public member kind、builder 和 source binding。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Existing field, method, spread and accessor tests remain green

Task.name: Add typed property characterization and contract tests
Task.Description: 添加 field/property/method/spread kind、显式 typed prop、class/trait scope、accessor-only compatibility、typed inline accessor runtime、伴生 method signature compatibility、kind matrix 和 symbolic target 的失败测试。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests distinguish Property from Field and Method in the public RowMember model.
Tests prove explicitly typed prop binds while accessor-only prop keeps existing behavior.
Tests reject prop in plain type/schema/mixin and define same-name/cross-kind compatibility.
Tests prove typed inline accessors execute without shadow methods and reject incompatible companion method signatures.

Task.name: Implement member kind and typed prop binding
Task.Description: 实现 RowMemberKind、constructor compatibility、Property builder、copy/substitution preservation、class/trait-only binding、kind compatibility 和 conflict diagnostics。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: RowMember kind survives WithType, effect/access projection, generic substitution and class row construction.
Typed property source uses explicit type and preserves TypeMetadata.
Subtype, slot lookup, member identity and inheritance enforce the documented kind matrix.

TaskGroup.name: Type-System And Code-First Integration
TaskGroup.Description: 消除所有 !IsMethod=field 假设，并证明 source/programmatic class model 等价。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Source-first and code-first structural-equivalence tests pass

Task.name: Audit value-member and storage-field consumers
Task.Description: 审计 typed execution/checker/runtime context 中 !IsMethod 判断，分别改为 value-member 或 field-only predicate；typed inline accessor 无需影子 method 即可执行，伴生 method signature 服从 property type，model-only property 执行时 fail with missing-accessor。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Storage construction/enumeration excludes properties while property access resolves as a typed value member.
Existing class projection, inheritance, access and generic behavior tests pass.
Typed getter/setter bodies are checked against property type and missing accessors never fall back to field storage.
Inline property accessors execute without companion methods, while incompatible companion getter/setter signatures produce stable diagnostics.

Task.name: Add source and programmatic equivalence coverage
Task.Description: 使用 RowMemberBuilder.Property 与 TypeSystem.DefineClass 构造 code-first 模型，覆盖 single/collection target、metadata、qualifier/access 和 symbolic references。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Equivalent source and programmatic classes expose structurally equal fields and properties.
Property metadata remains available without introducing an ORM dependency into core type-system.

TaskGroup.name: Public Boundary Verification
TaskGroup.Description: 运行 focused/full tests、typecheck/build，并 fresh 审查语言方向和下游可消费性。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Focused and full Kunun tests pass
No runtime to type-system dependency is introduced

Task.name: Run package and workspace verification
Task.Description: 运行 type-system/runtime tests、workspace typecheck/build、public export checks 和 diff review。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: All agreed test, typecheck and build commands pass.
Public package exports expose the typed property contract.

Task.name: Verify ORM-neutral navigation-property authority
Task.Description: 复核 property 是 Kunun class member、metadata 可供下游读取、schema RelationTypeSymbol 未被混用、package dependencies 仍单向。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: No ORM-specific vocabulary or dependency is introduced into Kunun core/type-system.
The public contract is sufficient for the downstream depa ORM track without a shadow class model.
